display.fallback: Georgia, Source Serif 4, Noto Serif KR

chart.plot_area: 6.0in x 3.6in (left 6-7 of 12 cols), right 5-6 cols = takeaway text
chart.type_match: comparison=column, trend=line/column, share=donut(<=3)/100%-stacked, change=slope, composition=stacked(<=4 seg), relation=scatter
chart.value_label: 14pt Inter Semibold, tabular figures, on bar end / inside segment, highlight value #2563EB
chart.series_label: 13pt Inter #14213D direct at bar/line end (no legend box)
chart.line: 1.75pt solid, straight segments, primary #2563EB / secondary #14213D, markers 6px endpoints only, no area fill
chart.donut: <=3 segments, highlight #2563EB rest blue-ramp, center 42pt PT Serif key figure
chart.slope: two timepoints, value+series label at each end, highlight #2563EB 2pt rest #A8B4C6 1.25pt
chart.render: SVG precise, 0px corners, no border box, no legend box, no shadow, no bevel/gloss/3D, no dual-axis
chart.title_rule: action title (conclusion sentence) is the chart title; no separate chart title

diagram.language: consulting standard; 0px-corner rect boxes, 1px #C7D0DD border, 1.5px arrows, 1 active/key node only #2563EB rest neutral
diagram.node: #F1F4F9 fill + 1px #C7D0DD border + 3px top border (#2563EB active / #C7D0DD inactive), 1.9x0.9in, 0px radius, padding 0.16in
diagram.step_badge: 0.32in square, 1px #C7D0DD border, #FFFFFF fill, Inter Semibold 13pt #14213D; active #2563EB fill + #FFFFFF
diagram.process: horizontal, <=5 steps, node gap 0.3in, 14pt Inter Semibold header + 12pt sub, 12-col snap
diagram.timeline: horizontal 1px #C7D0DD axis, 8px circle markers (#FFFFFF + 1.5px #A8B4C6, current #2563EB), <=6 markers, current = 0.75pt #2563EB dashed vertical
diagram.comparison: 2-3 col table, 14pt Inter Semibold header + 1px #C7D0DD rule, 1px vertical dividers, recommended col 3px #2563EB top border, ✓#2563EB/✗#A8B4C6
diagram.matrix: 0.75pt #C7D0DD cross axes (left 6-7 cols), recommended quadrant #F1F4F9 light fill, #A8B4C6 bubbles + highlight #2563EB, right 5-6 cols takeaway
diagram.hierarchy: 3-4 levels rect stack/trapezoid, blue ramp #14213D->#2563EB->#7CA0F0->#A8B4C6 or #F1F4F9 + key level #2563EB, 0.75px white divider
diagram.kpi_card: #F1F4F9 + 3px #2563EB top border, 0px radius, padding 0.16in; 42pt PT Serif #2563EB figure + 11pt kicker + delta ▲#2563EB/▼#5B6472
diagram.render: SVG precise, no div blocks, 0px corners, 12-col snap, left-aligned, Inter sans-serif text

slide.action_title: conclusion sentence mandatory, not a label
slide.transition: cut | fade 0.2s | chart bar build L-to-R 0.3s
